I need to find the remainder when 13^765 is divided by 464. Let me solve this using modular arithmetic.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
# Calculate 13^765 mod 464
result = pow(13, 765, 464)
print(f"13^765 mod 464 = {result}")

# Verify by checking the calculation another way
# Factor 464 = 16 × 29, use Chinese Remainder Theorem
mod1 = pow(13, 765, 16)
mod2 = pow(13, 765, 29)
print(f"\nVerification using CRT:")
print(f"13^765 mod 16 = {mod1}")
print(f"13^765 mod 29 = {mod2}")

# Check that result satisfies both congruences
print(f"\nCheck:")
print(f"{result} mod 16 = {result % 16}")
print(f"{result} mod 29 = {result % 29}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

The remainder when 13^765 is divided by 464 is **237**.

Here's how I verified this:
- I factored 464 = 16 × 29
- Using the Chinese Remainder Theorem:
  - 13^765 ≡ 13 (mod 16)
  - 13^765 ≡ 5 (mod 29)
- The unique solution modulo 464 is 237
